scope.behavior: Restricted publisher evidence build and private image pull output in public Actions logs

before_value.evidence_build: docker buildx build stdout and stderr are forwarded to the public Actions step log while the context contains raw private evidence
before_value.runtime_image_pull: docker pull stdout and stderr are forwarded to the public Actions step log for the private runtime image
before_value.evidence_image_pull: docker pull stdout and stderr are forwarded to the public Actions step log for the private evidence image

after_value.evidence_build: stdout and stderr are captured in a runner-local file, removed on success and step exit; failure prints a fixed category
after_value.runtime_image_pull: stdout and stderr are captured in a runner-local file, removed on success and step exit; failure prints a fixed category
after_value.evidence_image_pull: stdout and stderr are captured in a runner-local file, removed on success and step exit; failure prints a fixed category

decisions.compatibility_impact: Public workflow viewers lose raw evidence Buildx and private-image pull progress or diagnostics. On failure they receive fixed categories; job success/failure remains visible. Private proof capture and package publication checks remain unchanged.
decisions.replacement_behavior: Capture both streams of the evidence Buildx command and private runtime/evidence pulls in ephemeral runner-local files; remove files on success and step exit; print fixed failure messages.

scope.behavior: Restricted publication validation errors in public Actions logs

before_value.restricted_expected_error: OSError, BundleError and PublicationError details are printed to public Actions logs, including duplicate JSON keys from private proof data
before_value.restricted_unexpected_error: unexpected Exception traceback can be printed to public Actions logs
before_value.public_mode: existing detailed error messages remain available

after_value.restricted_expected_error: one fixed public message: ERROR: restricted runtime publication validation failed
after_value.restricted_unexpected_error: the same fixed public message for any Exception
after_value.public_mode: existing detailed error messages remain available

decisions.compatibility_impact: Public workflow viewers lose raw validation exception details from restricted private-proof parsing and see one fixed failure category. Nonrestricted publication diagnostics remain unchanged.
decisions.replacement_behavior: For --restricted only, catch expected and unexpected Exception failures and print the fixed restricted publication validation error without exception text.
